title: corr
summary: Compute pairwise correlation coefficients and p-values.

gpu_support.notes: GPU inputs are gathered to host for compatibility until a provider hook exists.

description: `corr(X)` returns pairwise correlations between columns of `X`. `corr(X,Y)` returns correlations between columns of `X` and columns of `Y`. `[R,P] = corr(...)` also returns approximate p-values for testing no correlation.
behaviors: Rows are observations and columns are variables.
Constant or insufficient data pairs produce `NaN`.

faqs.question: Does corr support rank correlations?
faqs.answer: Spearman and Kendall rank correlations are supported through the `Type` option. P-values use standard large-sample approximations.
